values.note: Non-electric sites in both loops $28 a night (CPW's camping page), the same on cpwshop for Tue 2027-06-15 and Sat 2027-06-19; CPW's fee table gives campsites $18-$28. A daily vehicle pass ($10-12 Colorado plates, $15-17 out of state) or an annual state parks pass must be displayed on top; CPW's reservation fee is charged per stay.

fees.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/pearl-lake-state-park/pearl-lake-state-park-camping-lodging ('Non-electric: $28/night - Pearl Upper and Lower Loops'; Fees 'Campsite ... $18 to $28'; 'Visitors are required to display a vehicle pass') + https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/pearl-lake-state-park (Daily Vehicle Pass $10-$12 Colorado plate, $15-$17 out-of-state) + cpwshop.com parkID 50035 site pages ('$28.00 /Per Night' on 2027-06-15 and 2027-06-19), read 2026-10-12 / 2026-10-27

hookups.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/pearl-lake-state-park/pearl-lake-state-park-camping-lodging ('Non-electric: $28/night - Pearl Upper and Lower Loops') + cpwshop.com parkID 50035 (every campsite type 'Basic', no hookup attributes), read 2026-10-27

values.note: CPW says 36 campsites plus two yurts; cpwshop lists 34 basic sites (15 lower loop, 19 upper loop) and the two yurts. Site lengths 16-30 ft: 10 sites take 30 ft, 13 more take 24-28 ft; a few pull-throughs. Gravel, level parking areas. One accessible site.

sites.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/pearl-lake-state-park/pearl-lake-state-park-camping-lodging ('The 36 campsites and two yurts'; 'Level parking areas'; 'One campsite is accessible') + cpwshop.com parkID 50035 site list (Maximum Vehicle Length 30 x10, 28 x1, 25 x3, 24 x9, 20 x8, 18 x2, 16 x3; Driveway Entry Pull-Through on sites 001 and 025), read 2026-10-12 / 2026-10-27

facilities.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/pearl-lake-state-park/pearl-lake-state-park-camping-lodging (amenities: 'Vault and flush toilets', 'Water hydrants', fire ring, picnic tables, tent pads; no showers or dump station listed), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Summer camping from the Friday before Memorial Day (May 28 in 2027) to September 30, fall camping October 1 - November 1; closed to camping in winter (the two yurts stay open all year).

season.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/pearl-lake-state-park/pearl-lake-state-park-camping-lodging ('Summer Camping Reservations: From the Friday before Memorial Day to September 30, 2027'; 'Fall 2026 Camping: From October 1, 2026 to Nov 1, 2026'; 'The park is closed to camping during the winter'; 'Winter season runs November 1 to the week before Memorial Day'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Reservation required, on cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead for summer (Friday before Memorial Day - September 30). October 1 - November 1 it is still reservation-only but bookable only on the day of arrival (cpwshop, the Steamboat Lake visitor center, or by phone). 14 days in any 28; one camping unit, two vehicles and six people per site. A no-show site may be resold after 24 hours.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/pearl-lake-state-park/pearl-lake-state-park-camping-lodging ('A reservation is required to camp at Pearl Lake State Park'; 'can be made 6 month in advance of your arrival date'; 'From October 1, 2026 to Nov 1, 2026, all campsites are by reservation only ... You can only book for the day of'; 'The maximum stay is 14 days within a 28-day period'), read 2026-10-27

note: Quiet wakeless lake near Clark at about 8,000 ft. The lower loop runs along the shoreline, the upper loop sits on a ridge with lake and mountain views. Two drive-up yurts with electric heat, reservable all year with a 2-night minimum; winter camping is at Steamboat Lake SP's marina lot. --Claude
summary: CPW park + camping pages and cpwshop site data: confirmed 36 campsites, 30-ft max, no hookups, vault/flush toilets and hydrants, $28 (2027), reservation-only on cpwshop. Added pull-throughs, season (Friday before Memorial Day - Nov 1), reservation season, 6-month window, fcfs never, 14-night max, vehicle pass in fees.note. Note: dropped the count/hookup/amenity/length/season/booking restatements.
flags: Re-pin: stored 40.7883,-106.8878 is in the lake, ~230 m east of the west shore (Esri imagery). The 36 cpwshop site points centre on 40.7893,-106.8914, between the two loops on imagery (the points fall on the loop roads, so they are trustworthy here). Suggest 40.7893,-106.8914 (or the lower loop, ~40.7895,-106.8907).

Waterfront (stored lakefront): cpwshop tags lower-loop sites 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' (sites 024, 025 seen; 'Site Rating: Premium'). The 15 lower-loop points run along a road ~40-60 m from the sandy shore edge, with an open grass/scattered-tree slope and foot trails between, no road or day-use strip. The 19 upper-loop sites are on the ridge ~200-250 m back (view only). Consistent with lakefront for the lower loop; no lead.
Site count: CPW's page says 36 campsites and two yurts, cpwshop lists 34 campsites and 2 yurts (numbers 001-038 with 006/016 the yurts and 007/017 absent). Kept 36.
Length: 23 of the 34 sites take 24 ft or more (10 at 30 ft); the other 11 are 16-20 ft - EKKO fits about two thirds.
Open: CPW says 'There are no closures at this time'; fall same-day camping runs to November 1.
